title: When Entropy flows: drifting along the route to Chaos
summary: Consider a smooth one-parameter family of vector fields defined over some smooth manifold transitions from order into chaos. Inspired by the Second law of Thermodynamics, one is led to ask: can we find a flow whose dynamics realize this transition? To answer this question, motivated by the Mallet-Yorke Orbit Index theory, the Arnold-Khesin scheme for hydrodynamics and a heuristic argument by Rene Thom, we introduce a construction that transforms any one-parameter family of vector fields into a new object: the "Entropy flow".
